input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

doc_friction.issue: The filter proposal cited the Ceramics Manufacturing Working Group guidelines as a source in hand; search could not find them online and akvopedia and the CAWST PDF mirror returned 403, so the facts came from the Emergency WASH portal's ceramic filtration page instead. Proposals should name a source a session can actually reach.
Limits (seo_title <= 70, description <= 160) are only learned on failure; the creative prompt could state them next to 'write a post'.

deviations.why: The proposal's reasonable no (a grandmother who will not scrub the pot her late husband carried home) did not fit pots handed out three weeks earlier, and overlap.mjs showed Malawi already used by three stories.
deviations.did: Set it in Nicaragua (unused) and made the no a volunteer's misremembered 'never touch the inside', which she keeps carefully until two people tell her the same thing.
deviations.result: The no comes from caution rather than sentiment, and it sets up the clean-side/dirty-side teaching scene.

notes: Project: Hearth & Horizon (headline shelf). Piece: the-filter-that-runs-slower, about 5,200 words, text only because audio is at 577 MB, over the 400 MB cap. Weekdays, Advent Sundays and the Year B Gospel checked in code; every count in the closing note adds up. Added the next H&H proposal, 'The square that stays warm' (urban heat island). Checks: node --test in the venture 20/20; run_venture_tests.py hearth-and-horizon ok; check_posts.py ok. No agent doc: nothing new for the next run beyond the BIBLE proposal and the friction above.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: researching, drafting and fact-checking a 5,200-word illustrated-by-numbers short story plus a blog post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
